verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Unreal Engine charges a 5% royalty on gross revenue after the first $1M/$3,000-per-quarter threshold (unreal-comm-9, unreal-comm-13, unreal-comm-1, unreal-comm-2), directly contradicting the studio-lead's requirement of a royalty-free license with no revenue share. No evidence in the pack supports a royalty-free or per-install-fee-free licensing model.
